title: Trophy with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e6a800"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cup" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd700"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ffb800"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e6a200"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="handles" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e6a200"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="base" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d4a000"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b08800"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Left handle -->
  <path d="M28 30 Q10 30 10 48 Q10 62 28 62" fill="none" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <path d="M72 30 Q90 30 90 48 Q90 62 72 62" fill="none" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Trophy cup body -->
  <path d="M28 22 L28 55 Q28 68 50 70 Q72 68 72 55 L72 22 Z" fill="url(#cup)"/>

  <!-- Cup rim highlight -->
  <rect x="26" y="20" width="48" height="6" rx="3" fill="#fff3a0"/>

  <!-- Cup inner shine -->
  <path d="M35 28 L35 52 Q35 62 50 64 Q65 62 65 52 L65 28 Z" fill="#ffe95e" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x="44" y="68" width="12" height="10" fill="url(#base)"/>

  <!-- Base -->
  <path d="M32 78 L68 78 L72 88 L28 88 Z" fill="url(#base)"/>
  <rect x="26" y="86" width="48" height="6" rx="2" fill="#c79a00"/>

  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="40" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#5a3a00"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="40" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#5a3a00"/>
  <!-- Eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#fff8cc"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#fff8cc"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M38 50 Q50 60 62 50" fill="none" stroke="#5a3a00" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="48" r="3" fill="#ff9e5e" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="48" r="3" fill="#ff9e5e" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Star on cup -->
  <polygon points="50,28 52,33 57,33 53,36 55,41 50,38 45,41 47,36 43,33 48,33" fill="#fff8cc" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Base shine -->
  <rect x="30" y="80" width="40" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffe066" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
